facts.fact: Burundi's Loi N°1/22 of 22 August 2024, the code of electronic and postal communications, was promulgated; the file's note reports that its article 1 applies to all transactions by electronic means including commerce by electronic means, and that Burundi has no free-standing e-commerce, electronic transactions or electronic signature law (the PDF itself is an image-only scan with no extractable text).
facts.system: Loi N°1/22 du 22 Août 2024 portant code des communications électroniques et postales

facts.fact: ARCT states that e-commerce activity on Burundi's territory is subject to a prior conformity obligation, applying the provisions of the code des communications électroniques et postales.
facts.system: code des communications électroniques et postales

facts.fact: ARCT issued a communiqué on 26 June 2026 calling e-commerce platforms and merchant sites to declare conformity, with a procedures manual, a conformity checklist and a declaration form annexed; it reports no declaration received or penalty.
